image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) standing in a grassy field. The bird has glossy black plumage with iridescent blue-green sheen on the neck and breast, prominent red eyebrow combs (caruncles), and a short curved beak. White undertail coverts are visible as a bright patch near the tail base. The tail feathers show the characteristic lyre shape curving outward. Legs appear feathered. Background is blurred natural vegetation.
